news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹15.67 (vs ₹13.25 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹15.67 (up from ₹13.25 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹2.31b (up 30% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹502.7m (up 18% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 22% (down from 24% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has remained flat but the company’s share price has increased by 37% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price gain to ₹324, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 22.6x. Average trailing P/E is 21x in the Chemicals industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 166% over the past three years.

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 6 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 6 new directors. 1 experienced director. 1 highly experienced director. Executive Director Govind Parmar is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2011. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited Announces Resignation of Saurnya Sajal Jain as Chief Executive Officer, Effective January 23, 2026
news.body: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited announced that Mr. Saurnya Sajal Jain has tendered his resignation as the chief executive officer of the Company on January 23, 2026, effective immediately on the delivery of the resignation letter, which was taken on record by the Board in its meeting on January 23, 2026. Consequently, he has ceased to hold any positions in the Company, including that of key managerial personnel of the Company, with effect from the delivery of the resignation letter. Resignation was resulted  as part of the board reorganization consequent to the change in control of the Company in terms of the share purchase agreement dated December 15, 2025.

news.title: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited Announces Board and Committee Changes, Effective January 23, 2026
news.body: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited announced that Mr. Sajal Jain (DIN: 00314855) has tendered his resignation as the managing director of the Company on January 23, 2026, effective immediately on the delivery of the resignation letter, which was taken on record by the Board in its meeting held on January 23, 2026. Consequently, he has ceased to be a key managerial personnel of the Company and member of all committees and positions in the Company, including the audit committee and corporate social responsibility committee of the Board, with effect from the delivery of the resignation letter. news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.89 (up from ₹2.83 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹453.5m (up 21% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹92.7m (up 2.2% from 3Q 2025). news.title: Zenrock Chemicals Private Limited, India Special Assets Fund III, ISAF III Onshore Fund, Special Situation India Trust fund managed by EDELWEISS ALTERNATIVE ASSET ADVISORS PTE LIMITED entered into a share purchase agreement to acquire 50.80% stake in Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited (BSE:524342) from Sajal Sushilkumar Jain, Sreelekha Sajal Jain, Saumya Sajal Jain, Pranika Saumya Jain, Sajal Sushilkumar Jain HUF and Shubhra Jain Sivaradjou for INR 4.2 billion.
news.body:
Zenrock Chemicals Private Limited, India Special Assets Fund III, ISAF III Onshore Fund, Special Situation India Trust fund managed by EDELWEISS ALTERNATIVE ASSET ADVISORS PTE LIMITED entered into a share purchase agreement to acquire 50.80% stake in Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited (BSE:524342) from Sajal Sushilkumar Jain, Sreelekha Sajal Jain, Saumya Sajal Jain, Pranika Saumya Jain, Sajal Sushilkumar Jain HUF and Shubhra Jain Sivaradjou for INR 4.2 billion on December 15, 2025. A cash consideration valued at INR 256.3 per share will be paid by Zenrock Chemicals Private Limited, India Special Assets Fund III, ISAF III Onshore Fund, Special Situation India Trust fund managed by EDELWEISS ALTERNATIVE ASSET ADVISORS PTE LIMITED.
